description:
Hold `%StdinFSM{}` in Terminal state. In the `{:stdin_chunk, bin}` handler (currently broadcasting raw bytes), call `StdinFSM.process/2`, broadcast each emitted sequence as `{:stdin_event, seq}` on topic `{:stdin_event, scope}`, and arm the next GenServer timeout from the FSM's returned `next_timeout_ms`.

Terminal already uses `{:noreply, state, ms}` for `probe_timeout_ms` (terminal.ex:321). Both deadlines must coexist — implement the gb_trees / sorted-deadline pattern from auto-memory `feedback_genserver_timeout.md`: one pending GenServer timeout fires for whichever deadline is nearer; on fire, dispatch to the right handler and re-arm.

When FSM timeout fires, call `StdinFSM.flush/1` and broadcast emitted sequences. Remove the `:stdin_chunk` broadcast topic entirely (raw chunks are now an internal Terminal concern).
title: Move FSM ownership into Terminal; multiplex flush + probe deadlines
